quotations.old_english: Of eallum geswincfulnyssum he gehǽlde hine
quotations.latin: de omnibus tribulationibus ejus salvabit eum

source_text: geswincfulnys, -nyss, e; f. Sorrow, affliction, tribulation; tr&i-long;b&u-short;l&a-long;tio :-- Of eallum geswincfulnyssum he gehǽlde hine de omn&i-short;bus tr&i-long;b&u-short;l&a-long;ti&o-long;n&i-short;bus ejus salv&a-long;bit eum, Ps. Lamb. 33, 7.
